meta.title: Pricing — pay per active student
meta.description: ReMix pricing for Sri Lankan tuition teachers and institutes: a monthly base plus a small fee for each active student. One student counts once, however many classes they join. 30-day free trial.

hero.title: Simple pricing. One student counts once.
hero.subtitle: A monthly base plus a small fee for each active student. No per-class cards, no charge for students who stopped coming.

active.title: What counts as an active student?
active.subtitle: We count each student once per 30-day billing cycle, only if they actually used ReMix.

counts.body: The student paid a fee or logged in at least once during the cycle.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.contact: Not sure which plan fits? <link>Ask us on WhatsApp</link>.

trial.a: You pick a plan and your first bill is based on the students who were active in the trial month. Everything you set up stays exactly as it is.

change.a: Yes. Move from Tutor to Institute when you add teachers or pass {max} students. The change starts from your next billing cycle.

students.q: Do students pay anything to ReMix?
students.a: No. Students pay their class fees to you. ReMix bills the institute, once a month, for active students.

migration.q: Is moving our data really free?
migration.a: Yes, on every plan. We import your students, classes and fee history from Excel, CSV or your current system.

finalCta.title: Try every feature free for 30 days.
